info.description: Generated from server/access.js by scripts/generate-openapi.mjs. Do not edit by hand. Send the session token as Authorization: Bearer and/or X-Session-Token (X-Token is also accepted); every header sent must carry the same token. Cookies are not used.

status.description: Mirrors the HTTP status (legacy field; /health reports "healthy").

Unauthorized.description: No usable session. code is one of AUTH_REQUIRED, AUTH_MALFORMED, AUTH_CONFLICT, SESSION_INVALID, SESSION_EXPIRED.

Forbidden.description: The session may not do this. code is ROLE_NOT_ALLOWED (role outside the route audience) or FORBIDDEN (handler check).

x-linecart-fallback.description: Any other GET serves the web app (text/html); unknown /api/* paths answer 404 JSON.
